from pydantic import BaseModel

# Step 1: Get all restaurants in Paris
restaurants_str = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")
restaurant_names = restaurants_str.splitlines()

# Step 2: Filter for Chinese cuisine
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)
chinese_restaurants = [name for name in restaurant_names if cuisine_types.get(name, "").lower() == "chinese"]

# Step 3: Get prices for Chinese restaurants and filter under 34 euros
restaurant_prices = get_price_for_restaurants(chinese_restaurants)
affordable_chinese = [name for name in chinese_restaurants if restaurant_prices.get(name, 1000) < 34]

# Step 4: Check which are open on Monday
opening_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(affordable_chinese)
# We'll use the AI assistant to filter for those open on Monday
class OpenMondayModel(BaseModel):
    open_on_monday: list[str]

open_monday_result = query_ai_assistant(
    "Given the following restaurant opening hours, list the names of restaurants that are open on Monday. Only include those that are open on Monday.",
    OpenMondayModel
)
open_on_monday = open_monday_result.open_on_monday

# Step 5: Get ratings and reviews for those open on Monday
restaurant_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(open_on_monday)

# Step 6: Use AI assistant to select the best rated restaurant
class BestRestaurantModel(BaseModel):
    best_restaurant: str

best_restaurant_result = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Given these restaurant reviews, select the restaurant with the best rating and reviews. Return only the name of the best restaurant.\n{restaurant_reviews}",
    BestRestaurantModel
)
best_restaurant = best_restaurant_result.best_restaurant

# Step 7: Get all car rental companies in Paris
car_rental_str = get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city("Paris")
car_rental_names = car_rental_str.splitlines()

# Step 8: Get car rental prices and filter under 50 euros
car_prices = get_car_price_per_day(car_rental_names)
affordable_cars = [name for name in car_rental_names if car_prices.get(name, 1000) < 50]

# Step 9: Get ratings and reviews for affordable car rentals
car_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental(affordable_cars)

# Step 10: Use AI assistant to select the best rated car rental company
class BestCarRentalModel(BaseModel):
    best_car_rental: str

best_car_rental_result = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Given these car rental company reviews, select the company with the best rating and reviews. Return only the name of the best company.\n{car_reviews}",
    BestCarRentalModel
)
best_car_rental = best_car_rental_result.best_car_rental

# Step 11: Print the results
print("Recommended restaurant:", best_restaurant)
print("Recommended car rental company:", best_car_rental)
